map.评估血糖波动的重要\"金标准\"指标。仅计算振幅大于1个SD的有效波动，取所有有: MAGE is the gold standard index for assessing glycaemic variability. It counts only excursions larger than 1 SD, taking the mean absolute value from every valid peak-to-trough or trough-to-peak, and is not affected by the baseline glucose level.
map.1. 计算所有血糖值的平均值(MBG)和标准差(SD): 1. Compute the mean of all glucose values (MBG) and the standard deviation (SD)
map.2. 识别连续血糖曲线上的波峰和波谷: 2. Identify the peaks and troughs on the continuous glucose curve
map.3. 计算相邻波峰-波谷的振幅差值: 3. Compute the amplitude difference between adjacent peak and trough
map.4. 筛选振幅 ＞ SD 的有效波动（以SD为阈值，通常1个SD）: 4. Keep the valid excursions whose amplitude is above the SD threshold (normally 1 SD)
map.5. MAGE = 所有有效波动振幅绝对值的算术平均数: 5. MAGE = arithmetic mean of the absolute amplitudes of all valid excursions
map.注：本工具采用简化算法，将连续递增段最高点作为波峰、连续递减段最低点作为波谷进行: Note: this tool uses a simplified algorithm, taking the highest point of each rising segment as a peak and the lowest point of each falling segment as a trough.

map.MAGE 与 HbA1c、SD 有何不同？: How do MAGE, HbA1c and SD differ?
map.HbA1c 看长期平均，SD 看总体离散，MAGE 专门刻画有意义的大幅波动，更: HbA1c looks at the long-term mean, SD at overall dispersion, while MAGE specifically characterises meaningful large swings, which relates more closely to the risk of hypo- and hyperglycaemic events.
map.需足够密度的 CGM 连续读数（通常≥24–72 小时），稀疏或不连续数据会低估: You need sufficiently dense continuous CGM readings (usually 24-72 hours or more); sparse or discontinuous data underestimates MAGE.
